name: aeo-geo-analyzer
description: Two skills that audit longform and short-form content from an Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) perspective. Scores citation-worthiness, produces page-level edit feedback, generates weekly topic queues for longform, and reviews tweets/threads/LinkedIn posts for AI-citation potential in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.
